policy.runtime_dependency: Every active runtime dependency is tracked in this repository or installed from a pinned public source.
policy.private_state: Credentials, personal profiles, receipts, logs, and live state are never source inputs.
policy.import_rule: Only committed reusable source and portable tests are absorbed; local working-tree state is excluded.

sources.scope: Base tree for the self-contained public repository.
Reusable cloud-browser auth implementation and tests are absorbed by commit, while stale branch-specific specification and evidence state is excluded.
The shared agent runner, context packet, token ledger, usage reporter, and portable fail-closed tests are vendored under skills/agent-runner.
excluded: Tests coupled to the source repository's legacy directory layout

sources.repository: Daisuke134/anicca-dais (private source-state repository; not a runtime dependency)
sources.scope: Portable booking, Capafy automation, browser fallback, and shared policy source are absorbed. Personal configuration, credentials, account identifiers, memory, generated listing artwork, and live state remain outside the OSS product.

third_party_sources.scope: MIT Capafy publisher and user client source under skills/capafy-autopublish/vendor, based on upstream 0.8.6 plus the private source repository's reviewed portability fixes; runtime tokens and config files are excluded.
Optional anti-bot fallback fetched and checksum-verified by skills/camofox-browser/fetch.sh.
